summary:
Frontend-only bug-fix verification of (a) blur-poster removal, (b) soft video fade-in, (c) mute wiring to hidden <audio>.muted, (d) 1080p broadcast regression, (e) chat/bid regression in DesktopLiveRoom & MobileLiveRoom. Seller was actively broadcasting during the test (real video track present, currentTime advanced from 4.669s -> 8.323s over ~3.5s, no freeze). Buyer login (buyer@test.com) verified — user redirected to /dashboard, auth prompt not shown inside rooms. ALL 6 requested checks PASSED with 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors across the full session.

DESKTOP 1920x1080: 5 open/close cycles of desktop-live-room -> in every cycle document.querySelector('.dlr-poster') === null AND dlr-video has .ready class with computed opacity=1 within ~700ms of mount (soft fade-in only, no blurred poster underneath). Inline stream-mute-btn toggles both icon (bi-volume-mute <-> bi-volume-up) AND the single hidden <audio>.muted (true <-> false). dlr-mute inside the fullscreen room toggles the same hidden <audio>.muted. Chat regression: dlr-chat-input+dlr-send delivered 'TEST_dlr regression iter4' (10 -> 11 feed-chat rows). Bid regression: dlr-mode-bid -> dlr-quick-1 -> dlr-bid-confirm-yes placed a real bid, dlr-top-price 21.360 ₺ -> 21.840 ₺, feed-bid rows +1. Video kept playing during fullscreen watch (readyState advancing, currentTime +3.65s over 3.5s wall time).

MOBILE 390x844: enter-fullscreen-mobile visible, mobile-live-room opens, document.querySelector('.mlr-poster') === null, mlr-video has .ready class with opacity=1. mlr-mute toggles hidden <audio>.muted on BOTH audio elements ([true,true] -> [false,false]) and icon flips. Chat regression: 11 -> 12 mlr-feed-chat rows. Bid regression: mlr-top-price advanced to 22.320 ₺, feed-bid rows +1. mlr-close cleanly unmounts.

No layout shift / no overlap observed; inline camera-section (with new [ ] enter-fullscreen icon replacing native fs-btn) and right teklif panel continue to render normally when fullscreen is closed.
action_items: None — all bug-fix assertions pass. Bugs from user feedback (blurred poster removal + soft fade-in + mute wiring) are confirmed fixed in production preview.

Environment note: DB slug row again drifted (auction 1 status/is_live had to be re-set to active/1 before the run). Same issue as iteration_3 — consider a periodic seeder / disable auto-end for demo auctions in preview.
Optional cleanup: iteration_3 already flagged that Laravel Debugbar overlays the mobile input bar in preview (tests strip .phpdebugbar before every click). Set DEBUGBAR_ENABLED=false in preview .env.
critical_code_review_comments: DesktopLiveRoom.vue / MobileLiveRoom.vue: video fade-in relies on @loadeddata AND @playing → videoReady=true; on autoplay-blocked browsers where video never fires 'playing', opacity would stay at 0 (black). Not observed in the preview (Chromium autoplay muted works), but consider also setting videoReady=true after N ms as a safety fallback so no user is left staring at a blank stage.

toggleMute() writes videoEl.value.muted directly, but the actual playback path is through hidden <audio> elements attached by useLiveKit — the <video> element carries no audio track. Kept for consistency but note the <video>.muted assignment is essentially a no-op for real audio; only room.setStreamMuted() controls what the user hears. Confirmed working in this test.
isMobile in Show.vue still evaluated once at mount (no resize listener). Non-critical — Inertia navigation re-mounts on route change.

Broadcast.vue publishDefaults look correct (h360/h720 simulcast, h1080 encoding, musicHighQuality audio, AEC/NS/AGC). No LiveKit warnings observed in the console during a live watch — 1080p pipeline appears to negotiate without regression on the viewer side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 requested checks passed; 0 console errors; 0 pageerrors)

seed_data_creation: UPDATE auctions SET is_live=1, status='active' WHERE slug='antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-T4Yf' (row had drifted again). Placed one real bid via desktop room (21.360 -> 21.840 ₺) and another via mobile room (-> 22.320 ₺). Sent chats 'TEST_dlr regression iter4' and 'TEST_mlr regression iter4' as buyer@test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is Laravel/Inertia/Vue (NOT FastAPI). Login form uses Turkish placeholders 'E-posta adresi veya kullanıcı adı' + 'Şifre'; submitting via Enter key on the password field is more reliable than clicking button[type=submit]. After successful login the user lands on /dashboard, NOT /. Auction 1 (slug antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-T4Yf) can drift to status='sold' between sessions — reset with a single MySQL UPDATE. Debugbar overlay still present in preview — strip .phpdebugbar nodes before mobile clicks. During this run there WAS a real publisher (seller@test.com had left a live broadcast running from a previous session), so the video area actually rendered a live camera feed and dlr-video/mlr-video hit .ready almost immediately. If future runs see no publisher, dlr-video.ready may not become true — that's the offline path (checking/offline state layers), NOT a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a bug-fix verification and all fixes are confirmed working. .dlr-poster and .mlr-poster have been fully removed from the templates (grep confirms no remaining element in DesktopLiveRoom.vue / MobileLiveRoom.vue). Video fade-in is driven by CSS opacity 0 -> 1 via .ready class toggled on @loadeddata/@playing. Mute button now goes through props.room.setStreamMuted() in useLiveKit which flips the hidden <audio>.muted — verified in DOM by reading Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('audio')).map(a=>a.muted) before/after each click.
